create_event_instance: create an Event instance to manage a list of callbacks for a pub-sub pattern
register_callback: register a callback function with an Event instance so it gets called on invoke
invoke_event: invoke an Event to call all registered callbacks with a given object
review_event_class: review the Event class and its observer pattern implementation for callback management
refactor_event_callbacks: refactor the Event class to support removing callbacks or limiting callback count
